entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This AGPL-3.0 context database offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated significant task-completion gains in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes graph-based retrieval by extracting typed entity edges without requiring LLM calls. It features gap analysis to identify missing knowledge and enforces verified zero-leak access controls for multi-user data scoping.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: Supermemory combines RAG and memory through a custom vector graph engine that supports automated fact extraction and byte-level deduplication. It features connectors for platforms like Google Drive and GitHub, sustaining sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to create agent memory that learns over time. The system integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or native Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It supports managed, local, and self-hosted Docker Compose deployments through Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This Elastic License 2.0 provider manages context trees using git-like versioning, including commits, branches, and merges. It features a five-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms speeds, primarily through non-LLM tiers, and includes an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It achieves sub-linear storage growth through episodic compression and supports integrations with MCP and OpenWebUI.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts such as traces, playbooks, and context bundles. It manages context through outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to assist agents with complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management using a SQLite-backed store and a hierarchical DAG of depth-aware summary nodes. It includes specialized agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material to ensure no messages are lost.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent by providing a self-hosted backend for the Honcho library. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves a 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data locally as human-readable YAML engrams. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and local embedders to integrate with MCP tools like Claude Code and OpenClaw.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It employs hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, to provide memory through MCP and Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context for Hermes Agent and OpenClaw by using block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. These techniques reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens during inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled result. It includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack acts as a memory kernel for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for agent queries.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing long-term memory as inspectable Markdown files. It functions without a daemon or opaque databases, utilizing DuckDB solely as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It uses SQLite and FTS5 for local-first persistence and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text ranking, and graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking for tool-schema selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to manage agent recall. It features a 1-10 importance ranking system to surface high-priority memories during context prefetch alongside BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: A Git-backed context layer that stores identities, projects, and workflows in reviewable Markdown files for coding agents. It provides a deterministic kernel for hash-checked proposals and receipts, supporting Hermes alongside Claude Code and Codex.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model with an on-demand summarizer and support for real, immediate event deletion. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory for Hermes through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage tools for searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows APIs to charge for access and agents to pay for services using only a few lines of code.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: A reusable plugin designed for local capability indexing and routing of skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP configurations. It offers five native tools for searching and fetching information, with support for opt-in automatic generation of tool routing notes.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It includes configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory provider that defaults to AES-256-GCM encryption at rest for stored data. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval modes and can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for models that support structured tool use.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A file-based curation loop that manages memory hygiene by identifying rot and contradictions in versioned Markdown files. It uses five slash commands to capture and recall data, proposing evidence-cited diffs for user review without requiring a database.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework enables autonomous engineering through subagent-driven development and a mandatory workflow of brainstorming, planning, and test-driven development. It functions as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools to execute complex software tasks.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that provides coding-agent CLI support for tools like Hermes Agent. It features a sandboxed iframe preview for live iterations and exports artifacts to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent security capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills alongside a dedicated verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate 62 distinct categories of detectable AI writing patterns. It is compatible with Hermes and other agents, offering modes for rewriting, detection, and editing in place.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution by allowing skill merging and cross-pollination across multiple agents like Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring skill development.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides spec-conformant agent plugins compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io. It features 12 metaskills designed to preserve state within a local documentation folder.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent. It includes ready-to-paste exports and integrations for platforms such as Slack, Telegram, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple coding environments including Cursor and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical lenses for specific tasks. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside an analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries for programmatic skills.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill transforms rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality control via a spec review gate featuring PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs code edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a durable harness for long-running agents using a local-first SQLite store and Git-based memory. It organizes complex work through five distinct lane types and a hierarchical structure of Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer roles.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin implements cross-instance shared memory using markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. They provide specialized capabilities for integrating Hermes Agent with Chainlink oracle networks and smart contracts.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent installation guides and configuration resources in Portuguese. It features a collection of skills formatted in SKILL.md that adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models directly into agent workflows. The modules include specialized capabilities for prompt optimization, cinematic inserts, and product advertisement directing.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and developer discourse into version-pinned skills with full audit trails and provenance maps. It ensures precision by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language for AI that executes via a single Rust binary. It audits workflows for types, permissions, and costs before execution and generates tamper-evident receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables the management of Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts using WebDAV and CalDAV. It utilizes HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords for secure communication.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client featuring a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections. It employs three-layer lazy loading and incremental discovery of tool schemas to minimize token usage.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: An intelligent skill retrieval system using a five-layer approach, including FTS5, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It narrows skill lists before LLM calls to reduce token consumption.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills that implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It integrates federated search with Hugging Face and GitHub.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: An ADHD-friendly personal execution OS that uses local SQLite storage for habits and study blocks. It connects to AI agents via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: A read-only adversarial code review tool that uses three parallel subagents to hunt for bugs. It combines deterministic pre-scans with a hardened sandbox to verify findings via proof-of-concept execution.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces, including Discord, Telegram, and CLI. It supports 97 languages and can reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine for state management and a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent skill for simplifying code in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, and Rust. It utilizes specialized Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents with a risk-tiered approval gate.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# and .NET implementation of agentskills.io that integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: A turnkey cybersecurity lab providing 2,077 total skills and over 131 tools for forensics, network, and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP, and NIST.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested tools for session management, multi-session reconciliation, and worktree recovery to maintain memory across agent conversations. It belongs in this list for its ability to orchestrate parallel subagents for architectural and adversarial code reviews.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It is included for its specialized utility in optimizing GIF files under 8 MB and embedding them directly into project documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It is essential for maintaining skill health through CI-friendly validation and weekly monitoring for specification drift.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It belongs here as a discovery layer that provides direct installation commands for tools across platforms like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to propose and gate skill updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators. It is unique for operating locally using the Python standard library without requiring external daemons.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses, supporting protocols like Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is a critical addition for agents requiring standardized financial transaction capabilities compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It belongs in this list for producing cryptographically verifiable certificates that prove a skill actually works.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python runtime selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It is included for its ability to resolve environment-specific syntax and verify project-compatible interpreters without new installations.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows agents to earn USDC by answering support bounties on the Base network without requiring accounts or API keys. It is featured for its decentralized approach to settling payments and managing bounty context via x402.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It belongs here for its use of semantic memory to integrate user interests into structured reports with AI-driven action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides local and private utilities for video-to-text extraction, document OCR, and e-commerce material generation. It is included for its specialized batch processing capabilities, such as applying brand overlays to marketing assets.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project exposes 191 tools via an MCP server to provide structured web data across 31 different platforms. It belongs in this list for offering five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes and various development tools. It supports both open-source and unfree licensed software, offering a reliable way to manage agent dependencies within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct hardware and user interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent in Termux environments on Android. The setup supports persistent memory, over 70 tools, and flexible backend connectivity through local Ollama models or cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging. It also enables automated workflows by supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs on Termux.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access, allowing users to define strict security policies for messaging and web searches.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a straightforward Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows for persistent state through mounted home directories and supports building specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes environments. It includes a REST API, CLI, and MCP server, providing detailed per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane for managing multiple Hermes instances through a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting Ubuntu and Debian servers, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation. It is designed for production environments to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework focuses on financial trading by coordinating specialized agents for sentiment, technical, and fundamental analysis. It supports multiple LLM providers like OpenAI and Anthropic, utilizing a Portfolio Manager to oversee final transaction approvals and execution.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: Mission Control provides a self-hosted orchestration layer for governing agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. It offers flexible access through Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages parallel coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for session persistence. It ensures secure execution by providing sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Container environments.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This project serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocols in stdio mode. It includes specialized detection for HTTP signals to manage payment-required states for paid API services.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this template scales Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills specifically for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: Swarmclaw enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers and durable agent memory. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and integrates MCP tools for expanded capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual approval for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the system to ensure precise routing and coordination between the specialized units.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: Gladiator creates an agent-vs-agent arena where two autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars using Hermes Agent for task execution. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition, displaying agent tasks, code, and live scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It automatically synchronizes indices upon file changes and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility that tracks token usage and financial costs across multiple coding agents, including Hermes. Users can monitor their data through a 3D visualization dashboard or submit statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other CLI tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate debugging and analysis.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to help Hermes Agent and other AI providers build better user interfaces. It integrates directly with markdown-supporting providers to streamline the UI development process.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This real-time widget tracks token consumption, account limits, and session details by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports synchronization across multiple devices, ensuring consistent monitoring of usage data for over 32 AI tools.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to build and operate applications. It is designed for autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins provides a collection of community-driven themes and ASCII art banners to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can create and apply new aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using simple YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser that enables autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This integration suite provides memory capabilities for platforms like Slack and VS Code using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports various frameworks including CrewAI, LangGraph, and the Google ADK.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps, finance, and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining specific skills and custom instructions for individual directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that supports 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs deterministic local checks to identify overlapping descriptions or inconsistent schemas and supports integration via GitHub Actions or pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also handles the setup of systemd gateway services and the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform monitors multi-agent systems using passive monitoring and active probing without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent with wake word support and barge-in capabilities. It functions without API keys or accounts, supporting 35 languages through Piper and nine through Kokoro.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate revenue via Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with the Tauri 2 framework, serves as an all-in-one configuration tool for Hermes Agent and other CLIs like Claude Code and Gemini. It provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users to manage multiple agent environments.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent alongside 21 professional assistants specialized in document creation for PPT, Word, and Excel. It supports remote access through a WebUI and messaging platforms such as Telegram, facilitating collaboration with both built-in and external agents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices without a complex build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single application.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: Hermes Studio is a comprehensive web dashboard that manages five agent runtimes with tool traces and file previews across ten platforms including Discord and Slack. It enables the creation of executable visual workflows that incorporate approval gates, loops, and detailed usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task handling. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for agent skills and memory.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other coding agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated controls for MCP tools and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to a Hermes Agent runtime for site-aware drafting in 31 writing environments. It enables live browser control with explicit approval gates to ensure user oversight of agent actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from an iPhone by pairing with a web server. It provides mobile management for agent sessions and tasks, including read-only access to memory and analytics.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight offers a desktop workspace with one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. Users can monitor code writes and diffs in real-time while tracking performance metrics like token usage and latency through a runtime dashboard.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a comprehensive control plane for the Hermes stack, featuring a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health. It distinguishes itself with real-time tool call visualization and an MCP server management interface for controlling server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit designed to track live quota burn and costs for Codex and Claude across fifteen coding agent sources. It operates entirely locally without telemetry, requiring macOS 14+ to aggregate and search historical agent data.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It stands out by integrating a WebRTC voice mode powered by OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It is specifically designed around an approval inbox, allowing users to review and authorize agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, provides a terminal-based interface for managing Hermes sessions and profiles. It includes a dedicated kanban board for agentic task management and tools for configuring skills and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA that functions as a Telegram Mini App, supporting background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with file attachment support and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows-compatible desktop GUI requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights, making it a highly portable option for running Hermes. It supports both cloud and local models via LM Studio and includes a dynamic tool maker for creating custom API and Python handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It offers integrated management tools for organizing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers within a visually styled environment.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring-focused dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs while allowing full inspection of skill source code. It offers a read-only view of environment variables and configuration to ensure system oversight without accidental modification.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that utilizes SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and supports isolated profile management for maintaining separate API keys and memory sets.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client coordinates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports real-time model switching during streaming chat sessions.
